summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running tests or repository code, per instructions. Changes: monai/data/grid_dataset.py adds PatchIter (builds the channel-prepended patch size and delegates to iter_patch with copy-back off), reworks GridPatchDataset(dataset, patch_iter, transform=None, with_coordinates=True) to iterate the injected generator, apply the transform to the patch alone via apply_transform(map_items=False), and yield patches or (patch, coordinates) pairs, raises NotImplementedError("image dataset must implement `len()`.") when len() is unavailable, drops the math import, and fixes np.float in the PatchDataset docstring. monai/data/utils.py: iter_patch now yields (patch view, integer coordinate array) computed from the padded slices, and set_rnd skips double-underscore attributes. monai/data/__init__.py exports PatchIter. docs/source/data.rst gains a PatchIter autodoc entry after GridPatchDataset. tests/test_grid_dataset.py (class TestGridPatchDataset) has test_shape and test_loading_array with the spec's pinned values, plus test_missing_len and a 3D start-position equivalence test. Choices: the test images are np.arange(16) reshaped 1x4x4 because that reconciles the pinned values with RandShiftIntensity's range; the two-worker block re-seeds and rebuilds its objects. Unverified: no tests were run, and the docstring example was not executed. Nothing was committed.
